brewery.brewery_description:
We're thrilled to welcome you to Eumundi Brewery – the spiritual home of our handcrafted flagship Eumundi brews!

Many of you will remember the Eumundi Lager brand, first crafted in Eumundi back in 1988. The great news is that Eumundi beers are now back. Thanks to a partnership with Lion, we were able to rebuild a brewery on-site and revive the much-loved beer brand. The new beers started flowing in August 2017.

While you can now enjoy our Eumundi beers at an ever-growing number of local restaurants and bars, The Imperial Hotel and Eumundi Brewery is the only place you can taste our beers tapped direct from the brewery tanks.

These beers have been developed by some of the best brewers in the business – Lion's Master Brewer Chuck Hahn, Eumundi's Head Brewer Chris Sheehan and Brewer Allan Tilden.

Our beers are crafted using quality ingredients and are perfect for enjoying in our incredible Queensland climate.

beer.beer_description: Late hopped with Australian grown Cascade and Ella, this flavoursome Eumundi Brewery Lager has citrus fruit and floral notes with a crisp aroma balanced by a light to medium malt body. A new lager recipe made with all Australian ingredients made to be as refreshing as the original Eumundi Lager the brewery was famous for. It’s pretty good to quench that warm Queensland afternoon thirst.

A fresh full-flavoured pale ale with mid-strength alcohol that will have you coming back for another. A delicate stone fruit-come-tropical aroma from Galaxy and Enigma hops balanced with a slight biscuity malt note for a deep golden colour. It’s pretty good for a lazy lunch in your favourite hotel’s beer garden. Like ours, right here in Eumundi.

An easy-drinking alcoholic Ginger Beer with a sweet clean nose, a very balanced and controlled palate and a pleasant finish that delicately lingers with that delicious burn you love from ginger.

It’s great for a cruisy Sunday session with a setting sun warming your face. It’s pretty good if you like your Ginger Beer with a little something extra!

Like fresh tropical fruit and a misty morning at your local Markets. Vibrant aromas from Mosaic, El Dorado and Sabro hops all served on a full bodied delicious hazy brew.

Malt: Pale, Wheat, Oats

Hops: Mosaic, El Dorado, Sabro

A light tart beer with a Sunshine Coast twist. The sour backbone of the beer along with a low bitterness allows the macadamia, pineapple, and ginger to shine through. Thirst quenching and appealing to both beer and non-beer drinkers alike.

Malt: Pale, Wheat, Oats

Hops: Mosaic, El Dorado, Sabro

GABS2022
Made for the Redcliffe Leagues Club.
We hail form the best ginger growing region in the country, and we love our beer and biscuits. This is our Brut IPA with classic overtones of ginger, cinnamon, and brown sugar all in one glass.

Josh Batten’s Black Cockatoo Smoked Lager has been crowned out Brewed By EU! Winner.

A refreshing traditional dark Lager. Classically light and clean, with a sweet malt body and pleasant smokiness, all on palate with delicate coffee undertones.
The adult version of an old fashioned lemon squash. It has Citra and Lemon Drop hops, alongside real lemons. A little bit of Queensland sunshine, right in your glass. Contains lactose.

This one involves all of our favourite ingredients, especially the deep citrus hop note coming from the Citra and Mosaic hops. Pours deep brown to light red, robust on the palate with pronounced rich and sweet malt notes, leading into lots of hops in the mouthfeel and on the nose finishing with a decent bitterness and alcohol bite.

A “Breakfast Stout” with an addition of coffee.  Brewed with Rolled oats and lactose this silky smooth stout supported perfectly by coffee and raspberry. Brewed in collaboration with “The Store Eumundi” No Fast Moves Breakfast Stout brings the Store’s moto to life while embracing the great coffee that is locally roasted and quality tested daily by the Eumundi Brewers.
Hemp Bock beer.

This West Coast IPA has aromas dominated with tropical fruit and citrus with hints of melon. Brewed to have a big hop aroma but a balanced bitterness this is an IPA everyone can enjoy.

Malt: Pale, Munich, Carahell

Hops: Strata, Citra, Eldorado
Pouring pitch black with a chocolately head, a smooth profile of dark chocolate and roast barley combined with a licorice root inclusion, all closing with a pleasant cool finish.

Light Amber in colour with aromas of malt with a hint of bread.  Hopped solely with Willamette giving the brew a delicate spiciness and brewed with loaves of 10 Acres Sourdough in the mash this Amber Ale is malt driven, slightly sweet and smooth on the pallet with a balanced bitterness.
Like a cocktail but better, its a beer! A perfect harmony between sweet and sour, with raspberry, lime and mint.
An easy drinking session ale with a balanced bitterness. Packed with aromas of citrus and tropical fruits.
Fruit Ale With Passionfruit, Orange & Guava. Easy wheat beer base, slightly tart/sour.

The ever popular XPA style is back. A full yet juicy body with a healthy hit of big fruity Australian hops in Galaxy and Vic Secret. A little bit more than a Pale Ale, and a little bit less than an IPA, this one is very fruit forward and a little easier on the palate with a manageable bitterness and a very big drinkability.

Introducing the TriffAle, a summer dessert in a glass! We’ve taken a Triffle and turned it into a beer…or did we turn a beer into a Triffle? Based on a English Summer ale, think and taste swiss roll, tinned peaches, custard, port wine jelly and a big helping of cream. Sorry, we’ve left the Brandy out!

Tastes like a lager, looks much darker. An easy drinking beer with a clean and balanced malt body, a reasonable kiwi and German hop addition and a subtle coffee like finish. We think it’s a nice contrast to our refreshing Eumundi Lager, and very much an entry level dark beer.

Our Altbier, ‘Old Bier’, is an easy drinking traditional Amber Ale, smooth and sessionable, based on the classic German Altbier style with some new world ingredients. The perfect beer for your Octoberfest, prost!

A fresh full-flavoured pale ale with mid-strength alcohol that will have you coming back for another. A delicate stone fruit-come-tropical aroma from Galaxy and Enigma hops balanced with a slight biscuity malt note for a deep golden colour. It’s pretty good for a lazy lunch in your favourite hotel’s beer garden. Like ours, right here in Eumundi.

And don't forget to follow us on Instagram @untappd so that you never miss the next badge drop!
